title: Contribution calendar: isometric 3D
description: GitHub's contribution calendar as isometric pillars whose height follows the day's count.

calendar.description: A contribution calendar: one cell instance per day of github.contributions, placed by orientation and projection, coloured by level. Replace components.cell to change how a day looks.

layers.x: {{ props.projection == "isometric" ? ((day.week - (github.contributions.weeks - props.weeks | max(0))) - day.weekday + 6) * (props.cellSize + props.gap) : (props.orientation == "vertical" ? day.weekday : (day.week - (github.contributions.weeks - props.weeks | max(0)))) * (props.cellSize + props.gap) }}
layers.y: {{ props.projection == "isometric" ? ((day.week - (github.contributions.weeks - props.weeks | max(0))) + day.weekday) * (props.cellSize + props.gap) / 2 + props.maxHeight : (props.orientation == "vertical" ? (day.week - (github.contributions.weeks - props.weeks | max(0))) : day.weekday) * (props.cellSize + props.gap) }}

cell.description: An isometric pillar: two side faces shaded by dark overlays (only when the day has a height) under a top face in the day's colour.
